 Wave Radio Interview: Shane Johnson & Kim Hulme – Medicare Open Enrollment
 Duke Dance 
 Posted on November 3, 2026 
 Post Views: 246 
 Shane Johnson and Kim Hulme from Bear Lake Memorial Healthcare stopped by The Wave Tuesday, November 3 to talk more about Medicare. Open Enrollment continues now through December 7. The hospital will be holding a Medicare Education night on Tuesday, November 10 at 6pm at the Oregon California Trail Center. This is a free event.
